stability.note: long-lived by ~9-10 orders (decay only via tiny mixing) — passes where E_g failed by ~38 orders (F199)

clustering_collisionless.free_streaming_caveat: keV -> WARM DM; Lyman-alpha sets m_s >~ few keV (non-resonant) / lower for resonant; clusters on galactic+ scales, suppresses sub-galactic structure
clustering_collisionless.coupling_to_SM: only the tiny mixing -> sigma/m << Bullet bound (F191 D2 satisfied)

mixing_window.note: naive single-flavour see-saw mixing (~2.8e-05) and non-resonant DW-for-100%-DM (~7.9e-09) are both X-ray excluded; the resonant (Shi-Fuller) nuMSM benchmark (~5e-12) sits BELOW the X-ray bound (~1.7e-11) and reaches Omega_DM — the surviving keV window. The nuMSM decouples the DM sterile's Yukawa so its mixing is free; the heavier two steriles do see-saw + baryogenesis.

abundance.note: non-resonant DW for 100% DM needs sin2~7.9e-09 -> X-ray excluded; resonant production reaches Omega_DM at the smaller, X-ray-allowed mixing

verdict: The model contains a GENUINE sterile state — the F47 right-handed neutrino, a total SM singlet with Y=0 structurally forced — and it passes every bar the E_g sector failed: stable (tau ~ 1e25-26 s, ~8 orders > age, vs E_g's 38 orders below), massive (clusters), collisionless (only tiny mixing). It is the nuMSM keV sterile neutrino, viable via resonant production in the X-ray/Lyman-alpha window, and is structurally tied to the F47 see-saw that already explains the small active-neutrino mass. The keV mass scale is ACCOMMODATED (free M_R), not yet derived — the remaining obstruction.
